name: Viana (Spain)
description: Dark crimson field charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Viana (the bars of Aragon within a bordure of the chains of Navarre on red).
history: Municipal flag of Viana; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
